title: Rubedyne Material Dossier 1.0
description: The complete structured document of one sellable grade of a cosmetic raw material. Normative text: SPEC.md. Vocabulary membership, references and view rules are checked outside this schema (SPEC.md section 11). Licence: Apache-2.0.

dossier_id.description: <publisher domain>:<slug>; stable across versions, never reused.

restricted_content.description: Informative: what the restricted representation adds.

id.description: Identifier, unique within the dossier and stable across versions.

date.description: ISO 8601 calendar date, reduced precision allowed: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

vocabKey.description: A key of the vocabulary that governs the member, or a namespaced extension key x-<domain>:<key>.

localizedLine.description: Display-only text per BCP 47 language tag, at most 300 characters each.

localizedText.description: Display-only text per BCP 47 language tag.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (EU included) or a group code of vocab/regions.json.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) relative to the element that carries the evidence.

source.description: A media element of kind source_document.

quote.description: Verbatim text of the source page.

supports.description: The members of the element this quote proves.

as_of.description: Date on which the content of the element was established or last confirmed.

curated.description: true: authored by a curator, not taken from a source document. Only in dossiers of route extracted or curated.

in_figure.description: The value exists only in the referenced figure; no number is stated.

content.description: Content in % w/w of the material as supplied.

ref_id.description: External identifier, for example a culture-collection strain number.

concentration.description: Concentration of this dossier's material in the tested system, % w/w.

subject.description: What was measured or what the statement is about.

non_standard.description: Explicit statement that no published standard was followed.

redistribution.description: allowed: may be redistributed; consumer_display: a consumer may store a copy and show it to its own users; none: must not be shown to third parties.

product_code.description: The manufacturer's code of this sellable grade or form.

grade.description: Grade or form that distinguishes this dossier inside its family.

inci.description: INCI names (CosIng spelling), in descending order of content.

refines.description: Restricted component that gives more precise content for the named public component.

complete.description: true: the public and restricted components together describe 100 % of the material.

as_written.description: The value exactly as the source wrote it.

key.description: A property key or a condition key.

points_origin.description: publisher_raw: the publisher's own numeric data; tabulated: copied from a table in a source document; none: only the figure exists.

disclosure.description: full: every line with its %; actives_complete: every ingredient that contributes to the reported performance is listed with its %; partial: anything less.

is_subject.description: true: this line is the material of this dossier.

report.description: A media element holding the study report or summary.

all_endpoints_reported.description: true: every endpoint measured in the study is present in this dossier, including those without effect.

support.description: Properties, datasets or studies that back the relation.

edition.description: Edition of the scheme, for example the IFRA amendment.

reference.description: Entry in the scheme, for example an annex entry number.

source_language.description: Language of the original when other entries are translations.

supports.description: Properties, studies or datasets that back a claim or benefit.

authorization.description: The manufacturer's authorization as declared by a distributor.
